texts:
Docs rot quietly. A page that was right when it was written says nothing when the code it describes moves.

Our docs now measure it. Every page names the source files it is about, and at every deploy git is asked whether any of them changed after the page was last written or reviewed. The badge at the top says which: verified against the code, or lightly out of date with the count of files that moved.

More than 800 docs are bound to more than 4,000 source files, and the whole ledger is public at three.ws/docs/freshness. Reading a page and finding it already right counts as a review, so nothing is faked with a cosmetic edit.
Open the badge and the ledger lists the commits behind every file the page documents, so whoever fixes the page knows where to look. Filter it by title, path, or the source file that drifted.
